1.w: For the law, having a shadow of the good things about to be, not the image of the things themselves, every year with the same sacrifices that they offer unto perpetuity, never is able to perfect those coming near.

2.w: Otherwise, would they not have ceased being offered, because of no more having conscience of sins, those serving having been cleansed once?

3.w: But in these [is] a reminder of sins every year.

4.w: For [it is] impossible [for] the blood of bulls and of goats to take away sins.

5.w: Therefore, coming into the world, He says: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.

6.w: In burnt offerings and concerning sin [offerings] You were not well pleased.

7.w: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come—in the scroll of the book it has been written about Me—to do Your will, O God.’”

8.w: Saying above, “Sacrifices and offerings and burnt offerings and [those] for sin You did not desire, nor were You well pleased” (which are offered according to the law),

9.w: then He has said, “Behold, I have come to do Your will.” He takes away the first so that He might establish the second,

10.w: in which act of will, we are having been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

11.w: And indeed every priest has stood every day, serving and offering the same sacrifices many times, which never are able to take away sins.

12.w: But this One, having offered one sacrifice for sins unto perpetuity, sat down at the right hand of God,

13.w: [as to] the rest awaiting until His enemies should be placed [as] a footstool for His feet.

14.w: For by one offering, He has perfected unto perpetuity those being sanctified.

15.w: And the Holy Spirit also testifies to us. For after having said:

16.w: “This [is] the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says the Lord, giving My laws on their hearts, and I will inscribe them on their mind,”

17.w: then [He says]: “Their sins and their lawless acts, I will remember no more.”

18.w: Now where [there is] forgiveness of these, no longer [is there] an offering concerning sin.

19.w: Therefore, brothers, having confidence for entrance to the holy places in the blood of Jesus,

20.w: by a new and living way, which He inaugurated for us through the veil, that is, His flesh,

21.w: and [having] a great priest over the house of God,

22.w: we should come near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, the hearts having been sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and the body having been washed with pure water.

23.w: We should hold fast to the confession of [our] hope, unwavering; for the One having promised [is] faithful.

24.w: And we should carefully consider toward stirring up one another to love and to good works,

25.w: not forsaking the assembling together of ourselves, as [is] the custom with some, but exhorting, and so much more as you⁺ see the Day drawing near.

26.w: For [if] we are sinning willingly after receiving the knowledge of the truth, [there] no longer remains a sacrifice for sins,

27.w: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and zeal of fire being about to devour the adversaries.

28.w: Anyone having set aside the law of Moses dies without mercies on the basis of two or three witnesses.

29.w: How much worse punishment do you⁺ think he will be worthy of, the one having trampled upon the Son of God, and having deemed common the blood of the covenant in which he was sanctified, and having insulted the Spirit of grace?

30.w: For we know the One having said, “Vengeance [is] Mine; I will repay,” and again, “The Lord will judge His people.”

31.w: [It is] a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

32.w: But recall the former days in which, having been enlightened, you⁺ endured a great conflict of sufferings,

33.w: this indeed, being made a spectacle both by reproaches and tribulations; now this, having become partners of those being treated thus.

34.w: For you⁺ also sympathized with the prisoners and you⁺ accepted the plundering of your⁺ possessions with joy, knowing yourselves to have a better and abiding possession.

35.w: Therefore do not throw away your⁺ confidence, which has a great reward.

36.w: For you⁺ have need of perseverance, so that, having done the will of God, you⁺ may receive the promise.

37.w: For “Yet [in] a very little while, the One coming will come, and will not delay.

38.w: But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he might shrink back, My soul is not well pleased in him.”

39.w: But we are not of [those] shrinking back to destruction, but of faith to the preserving [of] the soul.
